# Shared Workspace Capabilities

## Core capability families
- graph knowledge and object pages
- live workstreams and executions
- chronicle / review / recall
- code sessions and terminals
- host / repo / runtime bindings
- capture / inbox / promotion
- multi-user presence and attach
- approvals, recovery, and supervision

## Rule
These are not separate apps. They are regions/capabilities of one shared workspace.
